description: Liste des ports commerciaux is a data set listed in Tunisian transport sector open data portal (data.transport.tn), a sector open data portal, published or maintained by Office de la Marine Marchande et des Ports OMMP. ce jeu de données décrit la Liste des ports commerciaux de l'office de la marine marchande et des ports OMMP. Coverage: Tunisia. The portal files it under the publisher Office de la Marine Marchande et des Ports OMMP. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-01-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is OTL (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tunisia-transport-open-data-portal.
